summary: Configured node1 to pull /srv/inventory/data from node2 nightly at 02:15. Archives use inventory-YYYY-MM-DD.tar.gz under /var/backups/inventory, with archives older than seven days removed. The initially absent source directory was created. Both nodes passed sequential restart and recovery verification.
actions_performed: Created /srv/inventory/data on node2 with root ownership and mode 0750.
Generated a dedicated SSH key on node1 and restricted it on node2 to the backup tar command and node1's address.
Installed an atomic backup script and root cron schedule on node1.
Verified archive creation, readability, permissions, and removal of an eight-day-old test archive.
Restarted node1 and node2 individually, confirming changed boot IDs and recovery after each restart.
Completed a final end-to-end backup after both restarts.

evidence.requirement: Nightly dated backup from node2 to node1
evidence.summary: Shows the 02:15 cron schedule, successful archive creation, readable data/ content, and the final post-restart end-to-end backup.
An eight-day-old test archive was pruned successfully, and the installed script shows the seven-day mtime retention rule.

evidence.requirement: Secure source access and required paths
evidence.summary: Shows the source directory, active SSH service, node-generated backup credential, and restricted authorized key.
Captures node1's healthy baseline, restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovered cron schedule plus successful backup.
Captures node2's healthy baseline, restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered SSH/source state, and a successful backup pull after recovery.
